answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking a bond at the grove gate: each agent locks tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through verified work. Launching fake identities costs a full bond per key, so an attacker farming a thousand sybils burns real capital. Honest agents reclaim their stake on exit, while the garden of peers cross-attests work, and a nebula of independent validators flags duplicate behavior, slashing bonds. Attack cost scales linearly, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. Operator sa0034 applies this at XmTh26P133.
